svg.title: HUSSAR_YELLOW master pattern, size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58 (1 unit = 1 mm)

g.text: HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Close centre front. Staystitch and face each marked 172 mm fall slit. Leave outer knee vents open.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Cut mirror pair. Seat curve rises at centre back. Check seated depth in a toile.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Fold along centre. Leave both 102 mm centre-front sections independent behind the fall. Button the 32 mm extension.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Face the integral drop front; stitch at the waist and along both slit edges. Turn and button to the band.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Stay each marked slit. Clip to the lower end and turn; reinforce the corner.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Fold lengthwise. Match the 171 mm front and 193 mm back; leave 25 mm for the button overlap.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Apply to the back edge of the 66 mm knee vent. Finish the opposite vent edge.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Face scallops with regimental binding. Leave outer seam below knee open for buttons.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Face scallops with regimental binding. Leave outer seam below knee open for buttons.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Join the divided edge to the back opening, matching the calf station. Fold and set buttons opposite the front.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Cut a mirrored pair in outer cloth and a pair in lining.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Cut mirrored in shell and lining. Transfer the twelve cord paths before assembly; button the fastening front.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Cut a mirrored pair in outer cloth and a pair in lining.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Ease the cap into the armscye. Match front, side-back and shoulder marks.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Cut a mirrored pair in outer cloth and a pair in lining.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Cut a pair plus facing. Close short ends; apply at wrist.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Cut one outer and one undercollar. Match shoulders and centre back before setting the stand.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Cut a pair. Sew at the front opening, turn and secure to lining.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Cut a mirrored pair in outer cloth and a pair in lining.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Cut mirrored in shell and lining. Transfer the twelve cord paths before assembly; button the fastening front.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Cut a mirrored pair in outer cloth and a pair in lining.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Ease the cap into the armscye. Match front, side-back and shoulder marks.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Cut a mirrored pair in outer cloth and a pair in lining.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Cut a pair plus facing. Close short ends; apply at wrist.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Cut one outer and one undercollar. Match shoulders and centre back before setting the stand.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Cut a pair. Sew at the front opening, turn and secure to lining.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Place over the finished opening. Tack flat with nap toward hem. Meet hem trim at lower corners.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Join halves at centre back. Turn to fur side.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Join centre-back edges. The 590 mm base allows 10 mm over a 580 mm head.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Match the four lower quarters to the lower wall; align both back seams.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Match quarter marks; align long axis front to back. Ease evenly around the turn.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Join short ends. Match lower quarters to the hat base, turn inward and tack.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Sew mirrored sides and point. Turn, tuck the mouth inward and tack under the upper band.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Stretch across the palm. Use fine 1.5 mm glove seams; clip carefully to the marked webs.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Pair one back with the opposite-facing palm from the same hand. Use the named finger edges.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Widest point at the finger web. Taper each end into its named fingertip.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Widest point at the finger web. Taper each end into its named fingertip.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Widest point at the finger web. Taper each end into its named fingertip.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Close the short ends. Set the 86 mm lower ring into the two thumb openings. Place the tall point toward the thumb web.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Set the root to the palm half of the thumb gusset. Close both thumb faces around the tip.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Set this root to the back half of the thumb gusset.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Close cuff seam; match the 101 mm wrist halves to the palm and back. Bind the 292 mm flared opening.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Sew lining at both long edges; turn and finish ends. Fit tabs at the marked positions for a 39-43 cm neck.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Sew lining at both long edges; turn and finish ends. Fit tabs at the marked positions for a 39-43 cm neck.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Couch twelve cord rows; bind them in eighteen marked barrel groups. Work this face before adding the backing.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Join both long edges to the corded face; turn, finish the ends and add the ties over the dolman.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Fold lengthwise, sew the long edges and turn. Secure one tie to each end of the sash. Add a cord tassel.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Butt-stitch the shoulder ends. Fit the hip overlap and secure with costume snaps. Finish the long edges.
HUSSAR_YELLOW size 178 cm / C100 W86 H58
Butt-stitch the shoulder ends. Fit the hip overlap and secure with costume snaps. Finish the long edges.
